scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic, zero-start, unrestarted Euclidean GMRES on the unscaled right-preconditioned Taylor companion of the scalar affine family with real a,s>0; the diagonal embedding is invariant and does not cover generic systems, alternate scalings or finite precision.
title: An exact physical-residual resonance in scalar affine infinite GMRES
